repos.description: Status Trio — a native macOS app that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into one compact, configurable status icon for the menu bar, the Dock, or both, inspired by the iPhone Duo combined status bar.
repos.readme_excerpt:
Three system signals. One native macOS status icon — in your menu bar or the Dock.

Want to see it in action first? Open statustrio.lingai.net to simulate every icon state in your browser.

Status Trio is a native macOS status app that combines Wi-Fi, battery, and volume into one compact, configurable icon, shown in the menu bar, in the Dock, or in both. Its popover goes deeper than the icon: a Wi-Fi panel for nearby networks and link details, a Bluetooth panel for paired devices, a Battery Details page, and the audio devices that are playing. It is inspired by the iPhone Duo's combined status bar icon for Wi-Fi, Battery, and Cellular Data, adapted for Mac with Volume instead of Cellular Data.

> Status Trio is an independent project and is not affiliated with Apple.

# Highlights

• One icon, three signals — battery, Wi-Fi, and volume share one icon in the menu bar, the Dock, or both, and a Bluetooth device that is playing can take the middle spot with its own symbol.

repos.description: The batteries-included agent harness.
repos.readme_excerpt:
The batteries-included agent harness.

Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece.

• Opinionated — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work

• Extensible — override or replace any piece without forking

• Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local

• Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-class tracing, evaluation, and deployment via LangSmith

• Sub-agents — delegate tasks to agents with isolated context windows

• Filesystem — read, write, edit, or search over pluggable local, sandboxed, or remote backends

• Context management — summarize long threads and offload tool outputs to disk

• Shell access — run commands in your sandbox of choice

• Persistent memory — pluggable state and store backends for cross-session recall

# Linux on the ZTE F50 / MU300 and U30 Air

News and new releases are announced on the Telegram channel: t.me/mu300project. Follow it to hear

The ZTE F50 is a pocket 5G router. This project turns it into a small Linux computer: Ubuntu (24.04 or 26.04 LTS) or OpenWrt (plain, or with a control panel for the modem), with SSH, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and its 5G modem working. Android stays on the device, and you can go back to it at any time.

The ZTE U30 Air is supported too: the same board and chip with a battery. The installer recognises which one it is talking to; see Supported devices.

# Universal Android Debloater Next Generation

> DISCLAIMER: Use at your own risk. We're not responsible for anything that could happen to your devices.

This is a detached fork of the UAD project. This aims to improve privacy and efficiency (energy, speed, memory) by removing unnecessary and obscure system apps. This can also improve security by reducing the attack surface. Read the wiki for more details.

# Documentation

Everything about UAD-ng (and related stuff) can be found on the Wiki, such as:

• Features of this app

• Suggested Android app replacements

• How to get the cutting-edge version by building the source-code

• Weird things OEMs do

• Suggested apps for analyzing APKs

# Privacy

UAD-ng does not collect or transmit any user data. The only external connections are GET requests to GitHub for fetching the package list (crates/uad-core/src/uad_lists.rs) and checking for updates (crates/uad-core/src/update.rs).

The full full-stack framework for Rust

Topcoat is a modular, batteries-included Rust framework for building full-stack apps. It prioritizes simplicity and productivity. See Learn Topcoat to get started, or the Roadmap for what's coming next.

Early-stage and experimental. Expect breaking changes.

# What makes Topcoat different

# Client reactivity without the boilerplate

Topcoat renders all markup on the server: components can be async and query the database directly, eliminating all the traditional boilerplate needed for a separate API layer. Interactivity does not have to cost a round-trip, though. A $(...) expression is ordinary type-checked Rust that Topcoat evaluates on the server for the initial render and also translates to JavaScript, so it re-runs instantly in the browser. 把表格交给 Codex，把可编辑的科研图带回 Origin 理解数据 · 选择表达 · 定制样式 · 检查交付 三步开始 · 看图选模板 · 复制提示词 · 完整教程 · English

我做 EditaPlot，是想少花一些时间反复调图，多留一些时间讨论数据本身。你把表格和想表达的问题告诉 Codex，它会先说明每列的用途，等你确认后，再调用本机 Origin 绘图和检查结果。

它是一个 Codex Skill，不是独立绘图软件。你仍然可以在 Origin 中继续编辑曲线、坐标轴和图例；配色、线宽与版式也可以在已支持的范围内按你的需求调整。

使用前提：Windows 10/11 x64 实体电脑 + Codex + 本机 Origin/OriginPro。 日常使用不需要提前打开 Origin；Mac、Linux、WSL 和虚拟机暂不支持。

# 先看看能画什么

按实际列展示背景、包络和组分，不补造缺失峰。 同时看组间分布和每个观测，而不只看一根柱子。 使用上游已提供的逐样本 SHAP；绘图层不训练模型。 保留全部 900 个源值与行列顺序，不插值、不自动聚类。

这些示例都用合成教学数据，由真实 Origin 生成，不代表实验或临床结论。点击图片可以看原图。

浏览全部 45 条绘图路线 → 荧光 / EEG 研究信号 English gallery

# 开始使用

# 1 / 安装：这段话交给 Codex

不会 GitHub 也没关系，把下面这段话复制给 Codex：

请下载并保留完整仓库（包括 runtime），运行根目录 editaplot.cmd setup 和 doctor。 优先复用已有的 64 位 Python 3.11/3.12；需要安装 Python 时先问我。 不要安装或修改 Origin，不要修改注册表、DCOM，也不要申请管理员权限或控制鼠标。 完成后用中文告诉我环境是否就绪，再让我提供数据。

也可以下载完整 ZIP，完整解压后让 Codex 在该文件夹里安装。不要只复制 skill/editaplot 子目录，它需要仓库中的绘图引擎。

首次运行缺少兼容 Python 时，先按安装指南完成确认与配置。项目依赖只进入本项目环境，不修改全局 Python。

Steel.dev is an open-source browser API that makes it easy to build AI apps and agents that interact with the web. Instead of building automation infrastructure from scratch, you can focus on your AI application while Steel handles the complexity.

• Full Browser Control: Uses Puppeteer and CDP for complete control over Chrome instances -- allowing you to connect using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium.

• Proxy Support: Built-in proxy chain management for IP rotation

• Extension Support: Load custom Chrome extensions for enhanced functionality

repos.readme_excerpt:
# Inphic 鼠标电量托盘

给英菲克（INPHIC）无线鼠标加一个任务栏电量显示。支持 IN10（设备主动上报）与 IN9（Feature Report 主动查询）两代。

不修改原厂驱动、不注入原厂软件、不写入设备——只是监听鼠标本来就每 2 秒主动发出的电量报告，然后画在托盘上。

# 为什么做这个

原厂配置工具 INPHIC HUB 只在它自己的界面里显示电量，而且必须打开软件、点进设备页才看得到。托盘不显示电量，关掉程序就什么都不知道了。

Windows 自带的"蓝牙设备电量"对 2.4G 接收器无效，所以只能自己做一个。

# 特性

# 托盘状态

# 快速开始

# 方式一：直接用

• 右键图标 → 勾选「开机自动启动」

> 建议不要放在原厂软件目录里——卸载或重装 INPHIC HUB 时可能被一起删掉，开机自启就失效了。

# 方式二：自己编译

# 使用

# 工作原理

# 传输层

原厂软件是纯用户态程序，用 hidapi 走 HID Output/Input Report，没有内核驱动。本工具直接用 Windows 的 hid.dll + setupapi.dll 枚举和读取，连 hidapi.dll 都不需要。

关键点：用 FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE 共享方式打开。HID 输入报告会复制给所有打开该接口的句柄，所以本工具可以和原厂软件同时运行，互不干扰。

# 电量报告格式（已实测）

电量走在 Usage Page 0x000A 那个接口上（注意不是 64 字节的厂商通道），固定 5 字节：

# 上报规律（已实测）

最后两条是离线检测只能靠超时的原因：设备不会告诉你它走了，只能靠"沉默 8 秒"推断。

# 为什么是 8 秒

上报周期 2 秒，8 秒 = 连续漏掉 4 帧，不会因为一次抖动误判，也不至于关机后太久才变灰。

# 连接方式怎么判断

不是问设备，是看 HID 接口路径：蓝牙设备走 BTHENUM 路径，其余判为 USB。这和厂商自己的做法一致（原厂软件靠 VID 区分不同连接模式）。

# 图标渲染

托盘图标是运行时用 GDI+ 逐像素画的，不是预先做好的图片：

• 把 MouseIcon.png 缩放到系统实际图标尺寸（通常 16×16）

# Open Battery Information

This project aims to provide tools and information about various batteries in order to aid repair. It is very common for manufacturers to lock the BMS when a fault is detected to protect the device and the user. Very important feature! So when is it a problem? Well, there is always a chance for false triggering of this protection, or the fault could have been temporary or even repaired. In this case it would be wasteful to throw out a perfectly good BMS just because its software says it is faulty.

This is the problem we would like to solve!

repos.description: MDAnalysis is a Python library to analyze molecular dynamics simulations.

MDAnalysis_ is a Python library for the analysis of computer simulations of many-body systems at the molecular scale, spanning use cases from interactions of drugs with proteins to novel materials. It is widely used in the scientific community and is written by scientists for scientists.

It works with a wide range of popular simulation packages including GROMACS, Amber, NAMD, CHARMM, DL_POLY, HOOMD, LAMMPS and many others — see the lists of supported trajectory formats_ and topology formats_. MDAnalysis also includes widely used analysis algorithms in the MDAnalysis.analysis_ module.

The MDAnalysis project uses an open governance model_ and is fiscally sponsored by NumFOCUS_. Consider making a tax-deductible donation_ to help the project pay for developer time, professional services, travel, workshops, and a variety of other needs.

repos.description: A menu bar system monitor for macOS. CPU, memory, GPU, network, disk, battery and thermals at 0.046% CPU.
repos.readme_excerpt:
An ultra lightweight macOS system monitor.

AirStats is a system monitor for the Mac menu bar. It reads CPU, memory, GPU, network, disk, battery, temperature, process and host statistics from the kernel and shows them in three places: the menu bar itself, a panel that drops down when you click the status item, and a desktop widget you can leave on screen.

It is built to be genuinely light. A menu bar monitor runs all day, every day, so AirStats holds a few megabytes and a fraction of a percent of one core rather than the tens of megabytes its peers take. It has no Dock icon, and reads the system through Mach, IOKit,

repos.readme_excerpt:
# MiniWatts

An iPhone and iPad battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs. It reads the device's own power-management sensors — the ones iOS uses to run the charge — and shows what the charger is delivering, how much of it reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and what every temperature sensor in the device is doing while it happens.

> Sideload only. Private APIs mean this can never be on the App Store — you sign > and install it yourself. There is no network code of any kind: nothing it reads > leaves your phone.

# Install

Download the latest MiniWatts-unsigned.ipa from Releases and sign it with your own Apple ID — Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore and Xcode all do this. A free Apple ID works; the app then expires after seven days and you re-sign it.

Requires iPhone or iPad, iOS 17 or later.

# Razer Battery Report

Shows the battery level of your wireless Razer mouse in the Windows system tray.

> The app reads the battery level directly from the mouse. You do not need Razer Synapse.

> The app works only on Windows at this time. Linux and macOS support is planned.

# The tray icon

The icon is a mouse. The fill of the mouse shows the battery level. To see the exact percentage, put the pointer on the icon.

# Install

• Download the file that ends in -setup.exe from the

• Run the file. The app installs for your Windows user only. It does not ask for administrator

• If Windows hides the icon, drag the icon from the overflow area to the taskbar.

• To start the app with Windows, right-click the icon and select Start at login.

Portable version. The release also has a portable exe, without an installer. Put the exe in a folder and run it. The portable version has the same functions and also updates itself.

repos.description: See what your Mac is doing and keep its battery healthy with a charge limit. Free, open source and native.
repos.readme_excerpt:
See what your Mac is doing, and keep its battery healthy while it stays plugged in. Free, open source, native on macOS 15+.

A native macOS menu bar utility for resource monitoring and battery charge control. A click on the menu bar icon shows CPU, memory, disk, network, cores and battery at a glance; a dashboard window adds history charts, top processes and temperature sensors. Battery controls use the built-in macOS charge limit where available; macOS manages charging.

Download the latest version from GitHub Releases; what changed in each version is in the changelog.

Made by Sergey V. News and updates: @TheBlinks182 on X.

# Repository layout

# Features

• Menu bar popover with Overview, Battery and Processes tabs, refreshed every few seconds, and a global shortcut (⌥⌘M by default).

• Processes: find what holds a port or PID (3002, localhost:3002), see where it was started from, and quit just that process. Processes that keep a core busy show at the top.

[ Screencasts & Tutorials ]

# What is this?

Zellij is a workspace aimed at developers, ops-oriented people and anyone who loves the terminal. Similar programs are sometimes called "Terminal Multiplexers".

Zellij is designed around the philosophy that one must not sacrifice simplicity for power, taking pride in its great experience out of the box as well as the advanced features it places at its users' fingertips.

Zellij is geared toward beginner and power users alike - allowing deep customizability, personal automation through layouts, true multiplayer collaboration, unique UX features such as floating and stacked panes, and a plugin system allowing one to create plugins in any language that compiles to WebAssembly.

Zellij includes a built-in web-client, making a terminal optional.

You can get started by installing Zellij and checking out the Screencasts & Tutorials.

For more details about our future plans, read about upcoming features in our roadmap.
